metadata.description: Padosoft company skills, grouped by profile: you install the package for your stack, not the whole catalog.

plugins.name: padosoft-core
plugins.description: Cross-project skills, always on: router, skill creation, commit integrity, logging, failure visibility, test integrity, atomic invariants, docs drift.

plugins.name: padosoft-email
plugins.description: HTML emails that pass Mailtrap HTML Check, SpamAssassin and MailUp Check-up on the first send.

plugins.name: padosoft-api
plugins.description: Building and reviewing HTTP APIs: security review, Hono/Bun conventions, OpenAPI spec workflow.

plugins.name: padosoft-devops
plugins.description: Delivery workflows: PR review triage, CI gates that actually gate, cross-platform scripting.

plugins.name: padosoft-react-native
plugins.description: React Native / Expo: conventions from two production apps, mobile security review, screen and hook scaffolding.

plugins.name: padosoft-laravel
plugins.description: Laravel: conventions, security review with ten checks, scaffolding, and the admin/back-office interface pattern.

plugins.name: padosoft-payments

plugins.name: padosoft-ai
